---
title: "moved_genes_ancestral_location"
output: html_document
date: "2026-08-12"
---
This code is aimed to find preservation of the ancestral location of orthologous genes, which are moved between A. thaliana and A. lyrata. We test it by comparing orthologous genes nieghbors and preservation of their location between A. lyrata and C. rubella, as well as A. thaliana and C. rubella. The idea is that order needs to be preserved in A. lyrata vs C. rubella and disrupted in comparison of A. thaliana and C. rubella  
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggVennDiagram)
```

```{r}
# Read data 
transposed_genes <- read.table("/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/04_output/syntenic_and_tranposed_genes/98_1to1_orth_moved_genes.csv", header = T)

pannagram_1_1_genes <- read.table("/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/04_output/orthologous_genes/pannagram_simsearch/lyata_mn47_v2_thaliana_tair10.csv", header=T)
```

## Create a bed file with +/- 10 Kb flanking region for transposed genes (thaliana)
```{r}
head(transposed_genes)
transposed_genes_thaliana <- transposed_genes %>% dplyr::select(chr_thal,star_thal,end_thal,gene_id)
## Add +/- 10 KB to the both sides 
transposed_genes_thaliana$star_thal <- transposed_genes_thaliana$star_thal-10000
transposed_genes_thaliana$end_thal <- transposed_genes_thaliana$end_thal+10000
write.table(transposed_genes_thaliana,"/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/04_output/syntenic_and_tranposed_genes/thaliana_98transposed_genes_10Kbplusmin.bed",quote     = F, row.names = F,col.names = F, sep="\t")
```
## Create a bed file with +/- 10 Kb flanking region for transposed genes (lyrata)
```{r}
transposed_genes_lyrata <- filter(pannagram_1_1_genes, thaliana_id %in% transposed_genes$gene_id)
transposed_genes_lyrata <- transposed_genes_lyrata %>% dplyr::select(lyrata_chr,lyrata_start,lyrata_end,thaliana_id)
## Add +/- 10 KB to the both sides 
transposed_genes_lyrata$lyrata_start <- transposed_genes_lyrata$lyrata_start-10000
transposed_genes_lyrata$lyrata_end <- transposed_genes_lyrata$lyrata_end+10000
write.table(transposed_genes_lyrata,"/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/04_output/syntenic_and_tranposed_genes/lyrata_98transposed_genes_10Kbplusmin.bed",quote     = F, row.names = F,col.names = F, sep="\t")
```

## Create a bed file with +/- 10 Kb flanking region for transposed genes (capsella)
```{r}
# First calculate how many 1-1 orthologous genes defined in 3 capsella genomes
capsella_transposed_genes <- read.table("/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/04_output/syntenic_and_tranposed_genes/98_moved_gene_capsella_genomes.txt", sep="\t", header=T)
# How many genes have enteries in all 3 capsella genomes 
# function to check if a gene has a real hit (not NA, not "Not found")
has_hit <- function(x) !is.na(x) & x != "Not found"
set_grandiflora <- capsella_transposed_genes %>% filter(has_hit(C.grandiflora)) %>% pull(A.thaliana)
set_rubella     <- capsella_transposed_genes %>% filter(has_hit(C.rubella))     %>% pull(A.thaliana)
set_orientalis  <- capsella_transposed_genes %>% filter(has_hit(C.orientalis))  %>% pull(A.thaliana)

gene_sets <- list(
  C.grandiflora = set_grandiflora,
  C.rubella     = set_rubella,
  C.orientalis  = set_orientalis
)
```

```{r}
bar_dt <- data.frame(
  species = c("C.grandiflora", "C.rubella", "C.orientalis", "All 3 Capsella"),
  n_found = c(
    length(set_grandiflora),
    length(set_rubella),
    length(set_orientalis),
    length(Reduce(intersect, gene_sets))
  )
)

ggplot(bar_dt, aes(x = species, y = n_found, fill = species)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  geom_text(aes(label = n_found), vjust = -0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("steelblue", "coral", "lightgreen", "purple")) +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = c("C.grandiflora", "C.rubella", "C.orientalis", "All 3 Capsella")) +
  labs(
    x     = "Capsella species",
    y     = "Number of transposed genes with ortholog",
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

```
## Get bed file for capsella rubella
```{r}
capsella_rub_annotation <- read.table("/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/01_data/capsella_genomes/Crubella_RAM_exon_v3.2.gff3")
colnames(capsella_rub_annotation) <- c("chromosome", "genome", "type", "start", "stop", "v6", "orientation", "v8", "id")
capsella_rub_annotation <- capsella_rub_annotation %>% filter(type == "gene")
capsella_rub_annotation$id <- gsub("ID=", "", capsella_rub_annotation$id)
## Select orthologous genes 
capsella_transposed_genes_with_coordinates <- inner_join(capsella_rub_annotation,capsella_transposed_genes, by=c("id"="C.rubella"))
capsella_transposed_genes_with_coordinates$start <- capsella_transposed_genes_with_coordinates$start-10000
capsella_transposed_genes_with_coordinates$stop <- capsella_transposed_genes_with_coordinates$stop+10000
capsella_transposed_genes_with_coordinates <- capsella_transposed_genes_with_coordinates %>% dplyr::select(chromosome,start,stop,A.thaliana)
write.table(capsella_transposed_genes_with_coordinates,"/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/04_output/syntenic_and_tranposed_genes/capsella_98transposed_genes_10Kbplusmin.bed",quote     = F, row.names = F,col.names = F, sep="\t")
```
## Create a set of genes which intersect (Capsella rubella 1 copy, thaliana, lyrata)
```{r}
capsella_transposed_genes_wo_na <- na.omit(capsella_transposed_genes)
capsella_rub_single_copy <- capsella_transposed_genes_wo_na %>%
  filter(!grepl(",", C.rubella),
         C.rubella != "Not found",
         !is.na(C.rubella))
## Filter to have correspondance to lyrata as well
capsella_rub_single_copy <- capsella_rub_single_copy %>%
  filter(A.thaliana %in% pannagram_1_1_genes$thaliana_id)

capsella_not_in_pannagram <- capsella_rub_single_copy %>%
  filter(!A.thaliana %in% pannagram_1_1_genes$thaliana_id)

summary(capsella_not_in_pannagram$A.thaliana %in% transposed_genes$gene_id)
```

## Make dotplots for capsella, thaliana and lyrata
```{r}
install.packages("pannagram")
seq1 <- read.fasta("/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/04_output/syntenic_and_tranposed_genes/fasta_crubella_transposed_genes/AT1G05940.fa")[[1]]
seq2 <- read.fasta("/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/04_output/syntenic_and_tranposed_genes/fasta_lyrata_transposed_genes/AT1G05940.fa")[[1]]

dotPlot(seq1, seq2,
        wsize  = 20,
        nmatch = 9,
        xlab   = "gene1",
        ylab   = "gene2",
        main   = "Dot plot")
```
